summary: Combined photoelectric sensor form: Normally Closed Emitter-Receiver DC Driven 3 PIN.
description: A combined photoelectric sensor contains an emitter and a receiver within the same documented sensing unit. This entry identifies the normally closed emitter-receiver dc driven 3 pin form in the publisher's IEC-context family.

A reflective sensing arrangement can detect a passing object or a change in returned light and send the result to a control input. The normally-closed designation starts with a conducting output or closed contact in the documented reference condition; operation changes that state. This is the DC-supplied form. Preserve supply polarity and confirm the output circuit type from the device wiring diagram.
The combined housing does not establish whether a reflector or the target returns the light. Sensing mode, light-on or dark-on selection and pin functions need the selected product diagram.
